verdict.rationale: smolagents lets you compose agents hierarchically: a manager agent receives sub-agents via its `managed_agents` argument and delegates to them. You can also drive agents step by step with `agent.step()`, so plain Python can wrap them in custom loops. However, there is no evidence of an explicit graph or workflow abstraction; delegation is LLM-driven rather than a developer-defined graph. Missing for 10: an explicit graph/workflow composition API, developer-defined branching, documented loop constructs, parallel step execution, and independent hands-on corroboration.
